instruction: Work this out: A palindrome is a positive integer that reads the same left to right as right to left, for example 42124. For a positive integer n, let b be the least integer greater than the greatest digit of n (so b is at least 2), and let f(n) be the value of the base-ten numeral n reinterpreted in base b.
